title: Research and verification workflow installed (D-093): always-loaded rule, procedure, evidence records with a structural promotion check, SessionStart pointer, token cap removed, Northern Boulevard records
objective: Install the owner's permanent research-and-verification workflow (D-093) in the files the project already uses, prove the next session loads it, and apply it first to the five 215-16 Northern Boulevard questions without changing any report number.
business_reason: The owner should not have to repeat research corrections every session; results must not be promoted without source-backed, independently reviewed evidence.

acceptance_scenarios.given: the five committed 215-16 Northern Boulevard evidence records
acceptance_scenarios.then: it exits 0, prints each record's research status and whether its latest agent review applies to the current code, and calls none of them professionally verified

acceptance_scenarios.given: test records built in the test file: one with a required part missing, one complete, one whose linked code changed after review, one output with no record, one complete record asking for the Verified label
acceptance_scenarios.then: the incomplete, stale, absent and Verified-while-C1-open cases are refused promotion with a named reason; the complete record passes the structural check and is reported as structurally complete, not professionally verified

startup, resume, compact and clear payloads carry one bounded line naming the research rule (with its digest), the procedure, the records folder and the handoff's first line; a missing rule file gives a visible warning; the prompt-submit output is unchanged; the hook never blocks

acceptance_scenarios.when: python3 tools/test_context_budget_check.py and python3 tools/context_budget_check.py run
acceptance_scenarios.then: the eager size is reported and does not fail (owner D-093-R074); the stale, duplicate and retired-section checks and the handoff budget still fail closed

acceptance_scenarios.when: it is compared with the brief's section-2 rule
acceptance_scenarios.then: it has no frontmatter and differs only in path references (word diff in the producer report)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a checkout of the candidate head
acceptance_scenarios.when: disposable claude sessions (fresh, resumed, compacted) are asked about the policy, the handoff and the Northern Boulevard records
acceptance_scenarios.then: each finds them without this conversation; prompts, results and the transcript's loaded-instruction list are saved in project-control/reports/M0-T190-verification-sessions.md; untested session types are named

acceptance_scenarios.when: the five records are reviewed independently (G1)
acceptance_scenarios.then: the reviewer opens the decisive official sources and works the special-density example before reading code; findings recorded; no report number changes

acceptance_scenarios.when: git diff --stat against the contract head is read
acceptance_scenarios.then: no file under services/, apps/ or packages/ changes and no setting or access restriction other than those named changes

risks: An always-loaded rule adds startup context (owner removed the cap, D-093-R074; size still reported).
The structural check cannot certify a legal reading; it only blocks promotion without evidence (stated in the procedure).
Disposable claude sessions use the owner's account; they are read-only and restricted to read tools.
path_notes: Producer is the orchestrator for documents and records; tools and hook code may be written by one backend-engineer builder in its own worktree and cherry-picked. No product code changes. Scope correction 1 (2026-10-11): AGENTS.md (a pointer for Codex reviewers), the session-handoff profile (every handoff keeps the research entry), docs/WORKING_KNOWLEDGE.md (the old cap note marked superseded) and the 33 official data responses of the Northern Boulevard evidence pack, which .gitignore had kept out of git (added with the ignore overridden; each equal to its manifest SHA-256).

orchestrator part committed (rule, CLAUDE.md, procedure, five records, links, data files restored); scope correction 1; waiting for the builder (check, hook line, budget, CI)
